ko.title: 에너지가 물가 상승을 견인하다: 10월 소비자 물가 0.4% 급등의 이면

segments.src: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, a faster pace than most forecasters expected, while core inflation, which leaves out food and energy, held at 0.3%.
segments.tr: 10월 소비자 물가는 0.4% 상승하여 대부분의 예측치를 웃돌았으며, 식품과 에너지를 제외한 근원 물가는 0.3%를 유지했습니다.

segments.src: The gap between those two numbers points to the main driver of the month: energy.
segments.tr: 이 두 수치 사이의 격차는 이번 달 물가 상승의 주된 요인이 에너지임을 시사합니다.

segments.src: This article explains what the headline and core figures mean, which categories fed the increase, and why one strong monthly reading doesn't settle the debate over where inflation is heading.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 헤드라인 물가와 근원 물가 수치가 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 항목이 상승을 주도했는지, 그리고 왜 단 한 달의 강력한 수치가 향후 물가 흐름에 대한 논쟁을 종결짓지 못하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## 한눈에 보는 수치

segments.src: - **Headline consumer prices:** up 0.4% for the month, above forecasts.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인 소비자 물가:** 전월 대비 0.4% 상승, 예상치 상회.

segments.src: - **Core prices (excluding food and energy):** up 0.3%, unchanged from the prior pace.
segments.tr: - **근원 물가(식품 및 에너지 제외):** 0.3% 상승, 이전과 동일한 수준.

segments.src: - **The difference:** roughly 0.1 percentage point, which is attributable mostly to more volatile categories such as energy.
segments.tr: - **차이:** 약 0.1%포인트로, 이는 주로 에너지와 같이 변동성이 큰 항목에 기인합니다.

segments.src: A 0.4% monthly gain looks modest, but economists often look at what it implies over a year.
segments.tr: 0.4%의 월간 상승률은 작아 보이지만, 경제학자들은 종종 이것이 연간으로 환산했을 때 어떤 의미를 갖는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: If a 0.4% pace held for twelve months, it would compound to close to 5% annual inflation.
segments.tr: 만약 0.4%의 상승세가 12개월 동안 지속된다면, 연간 물가 상승률은 5%에 육박하게 됩니다.

segments.src: That is well above the 2% target the Federal Reserve has set.
segments.tr: 이는 연방준비제도(Fed)가 설정한 2% 목표치를 훨씬 웃도는 수준입니다.

segments.src: A 0.3% pace compounds to a little under 4%.
segments.tr: 0.3%의 상승세는 연간으로 환산하면 4%에 조금 못 미치는 수준입니다.

segments.src: That is why even small monthly differences get close attention.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 작은 월간 차이에도 세심한 주의를 기울이는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Why Energy Mattered So Much
segments.tr: ## 에너지가 그토록 중요한 이유

segments.src: Energy prices are among the most volatile parts of the consumer price index.
segments.tr: 에너지 가격은 소비자 물가 지수에서 가장 변동성이 큰 부분 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Gasoline, electricity, and natural gas can all move sharply from month to month because of weather, refinery activity, seasonal demand, and global supply conditions.
segments.tr: 휘발유, 전기, 천연가스는 날씨, 정유 시설 가동 상황, 계절적 수요, 글로벌 공급 여건에 따라 매달 급격하게 변동할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Energy has an outsized effect on headline readings for three reasons:
segments.tr: 에너지가 헤드라인 물가 지수에 막대한 영향을 미치는 데에는 세 가지 이유가 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **It is bought often.** Households fill up their tanks and pay utility bills every month, so changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **자주 구매합니다.** 가계는 매달 차량에 연료를 채우고 공공요금을 납부하므로, 가격 변화를 빠르게 체감합니다.

segments.src: 2. **It is volatile.** A swing of several percent in a single month is not unusual, which can move the overall index even when other prices are steady.
segments.tr: 2. **변동성이 큽니다.** 한 달 만에 수 퍼센트씩 등락하는 것은 드문 일이 아니며, 이는 다른 물가가 안정적일 때에도 전체 지수를 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **It feeds into other costs.** Higher fuel and power costs can eventually show up in transportation, shipping, and food prices.
segments.tr: 3. **다른 비용에 영향을 미칩니다.** 연료비와 전기료 상승은 결국 운송, 배송, 식품 가격에 반영될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Because the headline index includes energy and the core index does not, an energy-led month tends to lift the first number while leaving the second largely unchanged.
segments.tr: 헤드라인 지수에는 에너지가 포함되지만 근원 지수에는 포함되지 않기 때문에, 에너지 주도의 물가 상승은 첫 번째 수치를 끌어올리는 반면 두 번째 수치는 거의 변화시키지 않는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: That is the pattern seen in October.
segments.tr: 이것이 10월에 나타난 패턴입니다.

segments.src: ## Other Categories in the Mix
segments.tr: ## 그 밖의 항목들

segments.src: Energy was not the only contributor.
segments.tr: 에너지만이 유일한 원인은 아니었습니다.

segments.src: Several other areas typically shape the monthly reading:
segments.tr: 다른 여러 분야도 일반적으로 월간 수치를 형성합니다:

segments.src: - **Shelter.** Rent and housing-related costs make up the largest single share of the index. They move slowly, but they rarely fall quickly, so they often hold core inflation up.
segments.tr: - **주거비.** 임대료 및 주거 관련 비용은 지수에서 가장 큰 비중을 차지합니다. 이들은 천천히 움직이지만, 빠르게 하락하는 경우는 드물기 때문에 종종 근원 물가를 높은 수준으로 유지시킵니다.

segments.src: - **Food.** Grocery and restaurant prices can add or subtract a few hundredths of a percentage point depending on the month.
segments.tr: - **식품.** 식료품 및 외식 물가는 월에 따라 0.01%포인트 단위로 상승하거나 하락할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Services.** Items such as medical care, insurance, and transportation services have been persistent sources of upward pressure in recent years.
segments.tr: - **서비스.** 의료, 보험, 운송 서비스와 같은 항목은 최근 몇 년간 지속적인 물가 상승 압력의 원인이 되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: - **Goods.** Prices for many manufactured goods have been flatter, which helps offset some of the pressure from services.
segments.tr: - **상품.** 많은 공산품 가격은 비교적 안정적이었으며, 이는 서비스 부문에서 오는 압력을 일부 상쇄하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: A core reading of 0.3% suggests that underlying price growth remains steady rather than accelerating.
segments.tr: 0.3%의 근원 물가 수치는 기저 물가 상승이 가속화되기보다는 안정적으로 유지되고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: It also shows that it hasn't cooled as much as policymakers might prefer.
segments.tr: 또한 정책 입안자들이 바라는 만큼 물가가 냉각되지 않았음을 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## Why One Hot Month Doesn't Settle the Debate
segments.tr: ## 왜 한 달의 뜨거운 수치가 논쟁을 종결짓지 못하는가

segments.src: It is tempting to treat each monthly report as a verdict.
segments.tr: 매달 발표되는 보고서를 최종 판결처럼 여기고 싶은 유혹이 듭니다.

segments.src: Economists are generally more careful, for several reasons.
segments.tr: 하지만 경제학자들은 일반적으로 몇 가지 이유로 더 신중한 태도를 취합니다.

segments.src: **Monthly data is noisy.** Seasonal adjustments, weather events, and temporary supply disruptions can all distort a single month.
segments.tr: **월간 데이터는 노이즈가 많습니다.** 계절 조정, 기상 이변, 일시적인 공급 차질은 모두 한 달의 수치를 왜곡할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A figure that looks high may be partly reversed the next month.
segments.tr: 높아 보이는 수치가 다음 달에 부분적으로 상쇄될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: **Energy can reverse.** If the increase came from a short-term spike in fuel or utility costs, prices may ease later.
segments.tr: **에너지는 반전될 수 있습니다.** 만약 상승세가 연료나 공공요금의 단기적인 급등에서 비롯된 것이라면, 나중에 가격이 완화될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The effect on headline inflation would then fade.
segments.tr: 그렇게 되면 헤드라인 물가에 미치는 영향은 사라질 것입니다.

segments.src: **Core is the steadier guide.** Because core inflation strips out the most volatile items, many analysts consider it a better signal of where prices are going over the next several months.
segments.tr: **근원 물가가 더 안정적인 지표입니다.** 근원 물가는 가장 변동성이 큰 항목을 제외하기 때문에, 많은 분석가는 이를 향후 몇 달간의 물가 향방을 보여주는 더 나은 신호로 간주합니다.

segments.src: A steady 0.3% is neither a clear sign of re-acceleration nor of a sustained cooling.
segments.tr: 0.3%의 안정적인 수치는 재가속화의 명확한 신호도, 지속적인 냉각의 신호도 아닙니다.

segments.src: **Trends matter more than points.** Analysts often look at three-month and six-month averages, as well as year-over-year changes, to see through temporary swings.
segments.tr: **점(point)보다 추세(trend)가 더 중요합니다.** 분석가들은 일시적인 변동을 걸러내기 위해 종종 3개월 및 6개월 평균, 그리고 전년 대비 변화를 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: One reading above forecasts does not establish a new trend, just as one below forecasts would not have ended the debate.
segments.tr: 예상치를 웃도는 한 번의 수치가 새로운 추세를 확립하는 것은 아니며, 예상치를 밑도는 한 번의 수치가 논쟁을 끝내는 것도 아닙니다.

segments.src: **Revisions and surveys can change the picture.** Government statistical agencies sometimes revise earlier figures, and surveys of consumers and businesses offer additional context about price expectations.
segments.tr: **수정치와 설문조사가 상황을 바꿀 수 있습니다.** 정부 통계 기관은 때때로 이전 수치를 수정하며, 소비자 및 기업 대상 설문조사는 물가 기대치에 대한 추가적인 맥락을 제공합니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Households
segments.tr: ## 가계에 미치는 의미

segments.src: For most households, the practical effect of an energy-led increase shows up at the gas pump and on utility bills.
segments.tr: 대부분의 가계에게 에너지 주도의 물가 상승이 주는 실질적인 영향은 주유소와 공공요금 고지서에서 나타납니다.

segments.src: Those costs are hard to avoid, so they can feel larger than the headline number suggests.
segments.tr: 이러한 비용은 피하기 어렵기 때문에 헤드라인 수치가 시사하는 것보다 더 크게 느껴질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Higher energy costs may also leave less room in budgets for other spending.
segments.tr: 에너지 비용 상승은 다른 소비를 위한 예산 여력을 줄일 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Some general points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: 염두에 두어야 할 몇 가지 일반적인 사항:

segments.src: - Track your own spending categories rather than relying only on national averages. Your personal inflation rate depends on what you buy.
segments.tr: - 국가 평균에만 의존하지 말고 자신의 소비 항목을 추적하세요. 개인의 물가 상승률은 무엇을 구매하느냐에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: - Seasonal changes in heating and cooling costs can be planned for ahead of time.
segments.tr: - 냉난방 비용의 계절적 변화는 미리 계획할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - Short-term price moves in energy often don't last, so large financial decisions made on one month's data carry more risk.
segments.tr: - 에너지 가격의 단기적인 움직임은 지속되지 않는 경우가 많으므로, 한 달 치 데이터에 근거한 큰 재무적 결정은 더 많은 위험을 수반합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 다음으로 주목할 점

segments.src: Several indicators will help show whether October was a one-off or part of a broader pattern:
segments.tr: 다음 지표들은 10월의 수치가 일회성인지 아니면 더 넓은 패턴의 일부인지를 보여주는 데 도움이 될 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Next month's CPI report**, especially the core figure and the energy component.
segments.tr: - **다음 달 소비자 물가 지수(CPI) 보고서**, 특히 근원 수치와 에너지 구성 요소.

segments.src: - **Wholesale and producer prices**, which can signal pressure that has not yet reached consumers.
segments.tr: - **도매 및 생산자 물가**, 이는 아직 소비자에게 도달하지 않은 압력을 나타낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Wage growth**, since rising pay can sustain demand for services.
segments.tr: - **임금 상승률**, 임금 상승은 서비스에 대한 수요를 지속시킬 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: - **Central bank communications**, which show how policymakers read the data and whether they see risks to their inflation goal.
segments.tr: - **중앙은행의 커뮤니케이션**, 이는 정책 입안자들이 데이터를 어떻게 해석하는지, 그리고 물가 목표에 대한 위험을 어떻게 보는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: October's 0.4% increase was a firmer reading than expected, and energy did much of the work.
segments.tr: 10월의 0.4% 상승은 예상보다 견고한 수치였으며, 에너지가 큰 역할을 했습니다.

segments.src: With core inflation steady at 0.3%, the report points to ongoing but not accelerating underlying price pressure.
segments.tr: 근원 물가가 0.3%로 안정적인 상황에서, 이번 보고서는 기저 물가 압력이 지속되고 있지만 가속화되지는 않고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: A single month is a data point, not a trend, and the inflation debate will turn on whether the coming months confirm or reverse what October showed.
segments.tr: 한 달의 수치는 데이터 포인트일 뿐 추세가 아니며, 향후 물가 논쟁은 다가오는 몇 달이 10월의 결과를 확인해 줄지 아니면 반전시킬지에 달려 있습니다.

zh.title: 能源推动通胀走高：深入解析10月份消费者价格0.4%的涨幅

segments.src: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, a faster pace than most forecasters expected, while core inflation, which leaves out food and energy, held at 0.3%.
segments.tr: 10月份消费者价格上涨了0.4%，涨幅超过了大多数预测者的预期，而剔除食品和能源后的核心通胀率则保持在0.3%。

segments.src: The gap between those two numbers points to the main driver of the month: energy.
segments.tr: 这两个数字之间的差距指出了当月的主要驱动因素：能源。

segments.src: This article explains what the headline and core figures mean, which categories fed the increase, and why one strong monthly reading doesn't settle the debate over where inflation is heading.
segments.tr: 本文将解释整体通胀数据和核心通胀数据的含义，哪些类别推动了增长，以及为什么单月的强劲数据并不能平息关于通胀走向的争论。

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## 数据概览

segments.src: - **Headline consumer prices:** up 0.4% for the month, above forecasts.
segments.tr: - **整体消费者价格：** 当月上涨0.4%，高于预期。

segments.src: - **Core prices (excluding food and energy):** up 0.3%, unchanged from the prior pace.
segments.tr: - **核心价格（剔除食品和能源）：** 上涨0.3%，与此前增速持平。

segments.src: - **The difference:** roughly 0.1 percentage point, which is attributable mostly to more volatile categories such as energy.
segments.tr: - **差异：** 大约0.1个百分点，这主要归因于能源等波动性较大的类别。

segments.src: A 0.4% monthly gain looks modest, but economists often look at what it implies over a year.
segments.tr: 0.4%的月度涨幅看起来并不大，但经济学家通常会观察其年化影响。

segments.src: If a 0.4% pace held for twelve months, it would compound to close to 5% annual inflation.
segments.tr: 如果0.4%的增速持续十二个月，年化通胀率将接近5%。

segments.src: That is well above the 2% target the Federal Reserve has set.
segments.tr: 这远高于美联储设定的2%的目标。

segments.src: A 0.3% pace compounds to a little under 4%.
segments.tr: 0.3%的增速年化后略低于4%。

segments.src: That is why even small monthly differences get close attention.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么即使是微小的月度差异也会受到密切关注。

segments.src: ## Why Energy Mattered So Much
segments.tr: ## 为什么能源如此重要

segments.src: Energy prices are among the most volatile parts of the consumer price index.
segments.tr: 能源价格是消费者价格指数中最不稳定的部分之一。

segments.src: Gasoline, electricity, and natural gas can all move sharply from month to month because of weather, refinery activity, seasonal demand, and global supply conditions.
segments.tr: 汽油、电力和天然气的价格可能会因天气、炼油厂活动、季节性需求和全球供应状况而出现剧烈波动。

segments.src: Energy has an outsized effect on headline readings for three reasons:
segments.tr: 能源对整体通胀数据产生巨大影响的原因有三点：

segments.src: 1. **It is bought often.** Households fill up their tanks and pay utility bills every month, so changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **购买频率高。** 家庭每月都要加油和支付水电费，因此价格变化感受明显。

segments.src: 2. **It is volatile.** A swing of several percent in a single month is not unusual, which can move the overall index even when other prices are steady.
segments.tr: 2. **波动性大。** 单月波动几个百分点并不罕见，即使其他价格保持稳定，这也可能带动整体指数波动。

segments.src: 3. **It feeds into other costs.** Higher fuel and power costs can eventually show up in transportation, shipping, and food prices.
segments.tr: 3. **传导至其他成本。** 燃料和电力成本的上升最终可能会体现在交通、运输和食品价格中。

segments.src: Because the headline index includes energy and the core index does not, an energy-led month tends to lift the first number while leaving the second largely unchanged.
segments.tr: 由于整体指数包含能源而核心指数不包含，因此以能源为主导的月份往往会推高前者，而后者基本保持不变。

segments.src: That is the pattern seen in October.
segments.tr: 这就是10月份所呈现的模式。

segments.src: ## Other Categories in the Mix
segments.tr: ## 组合中的其他类别

segments.src: Energy was not the only contributor.
segments.tr: 能源并不是唯一的贡献者。

segments.src: Several other areas typically shape the monthly reading:
segments.tr: 其他几个领域通常也会影响月度数据：

segments.src: - **Shelter.** Rent and housing-related costs make up the largest single share of the index. They move slowly, but they rarely fall quickly, so they often hold core inflation up.
segments.tr: - **住房。** 租金和住房相关成本在指数中占比最大。它们变动缓慢，但很少迅速下降，因此往往会支撑核心通胀。

segments.src: - **Food.** Grocery and restaurant prices can add or subtract a few hundredths of a percentage point depending on the month.
segments.tr: - **食品。** 杂货和餐饮价格可能会根据月份的不同，增加或减少几个百分点。

segments.src: - **Services.** Items such as medical care, insurance, and transportation services have been persistent sources of upward pressure in recent years.
segments.tr: - **服务。** 医疗保健、保险和运输服务等项目近年来一直是持续的上涨压力来源。

segments.src: - **Goods.** Prices for many manufactured goods have been flatter, which helps offset some of the pressure from services.
segments.tr: - **商品。** 许多制成品的价格相对平稳，这有助于抵消部分来自服务的压力。

segments.src: A core reading of 0.3% suggests that underlying price growth remains steady rather than accelerating.
segments.tr: 0.3%的核心通胀率表明潜在的价格增长保持稳定，而非加速。

segments.src: It also shows that it hasn't cooled as much as policymakers might prefer.
segments.tr: 这也表明它并没有像政策制定者所希望的那样降温。

segments.src: ## Why One Hot Month Doesn't Settle the Debate
segments.tr: ## 为什么单月的高数据不能平息争论

segments.src: It is tempting to treat each monthly report as a verdict.
segments.tr: 人们很容易将每月的报告视为定论。

segments.src: Economists are generally more careful, for several reasons.
segments.tr: 但出于几个原因，经济学家通常会更加谨慎。

segments.src: **Monthly data is noisy.** Seasonal adjustments, weather events, and temporary supply disruptions can all distort a single month.
segments.tr: **月度数据存在噪音。** 季节性调整、天气事件和临时供应中断都可能扭曲单月数据。

segments.src: A figure that looks high may be partly reversed the next month.
segments.tr: 看起来很高的数据可能会在下个月部分回落。

segments.src: **Energy can reverse.** If the increase came from a short-term spike in fuel or utility costs, prices may ease later.
segments.tr: **能源价格可能会反转。** 如果涨幅来自燃料或公用事业成本的短期飙升，价格随后可能会回落。

segments.src: The effect on headline inflation would then fade.
segments.tr: 届时对整体通胀的影响就会减弱。

segments.src: **Core is the steadier guide.** Because core inflation strips out the most volatile items, many analysts consider it a better signal of where prices are going over the next several months.
segments.tr: **核心通胀是更稳定的指标。** 由于核心通胀剔除了波动最大的项目，许多分析师认为它是衡量未来几个月价格走势的更好信号。

segments.src: A steady 0.3% is neither a clear sign of re-acceleration nor of a sustained cooling.
segments.tr: 稳定的0.3%既不是重新加速的明确信号，也不是持续降温的信号。

segments.src: **Trends matter more than points.** Analysts often look at three-month and six-month averages, as well as year-over-year changes, to see through temporary swings.
segments.tr: **趋势比单点数据更重要。** 分析师通常会观察三个月和六个月的平均值，以及同比变化，以看透暂时的波动。

segments.src: One reading above forecasts does not establish a new trend, just as one below forecasts would not have ended the debate.
segments.tr: 一个高于预期的数据并不能确立新趋势，就像一个低于预期的数据也不会结束争论一样。

segments.src: **Revisions and surveys can change the picture.** Government statistical agencies sometimes revise earlier figures, and surveys of consumers and businesses offer additional context about price expectations.
segments.tr: **修正和调查可能会改变局面。** 政府统计机构有时会修正早期数据，而对消费者和企业的调查则提供了关于价格预期的额外背景信息。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Households
segments.tr: ## 这对家庭意味着什么

segments.src: For most households, the practical effect of an energy-led increase shows up at the gas pump and on utility bills.
segments.tr: 对于大多数家庭来说，能源主导的上涨带来的实际影响体现在加油站和水电费账单上。

segments.src: Those costs are hard to avoid, so they can feel larger than the headline number suggests.
segments.tr: 这些成本很难避免，因此它们带来的感受可能比整体数据所显示的要大。

segments.src: Higher energy costs may also leave less room in budgets for other spending.
segments.tr: 更高的能源成本也可能导致预算中用于其他支出的空间减少。

segments.src: Some general points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: 需要记住的一些一般性要点：

segments.src: - Track your own spending categories rather than relying only on national averages. Your personal inflation rate depends on what you buy.
segments.tr: - 跟踪你自己的支出类别，而不是仅仅依赖全国平均水平。你的个人通胀率取决于你购买的东西。

segments.src: - Seasonal changes in heating and cooling costs can be planned for ahead of time.
segments.tr: - 供暖和制冷成本的季节性变化是可以提前规划的。

segments.src: - Short-term price moves in energy often don't last, so large financial decisions made on one month's data carry more risk.
segments.tr: - 能源价格的短期波动往往不会持续，因此基于单月数据做出的重大财务决策风险更高。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 下一步关注什么

segments.src: Several indicators will help show whether October was a one-off or part of a broader pattern:
segments.tr: 几个指标将有助于判断10月份的数据是偶然现象还是更广泛模式的一部分：

segments.src: - **Next month's CPI report**, especially the core figure and the energy component.
segments.tr: - **下个月的CPI报告**，特别是核心数据和能源部分。

segments.src: - **Wholesale and producer prices**, which can signal pressure that has not yet reached consumers.
segments.tr: - **批发和生产者价格**，这可能预示着尚未传导至消费者的压力。

segments.src: - **Wage growth**, since rising pay can sustain demand for services.
segments.tr: - **工资增长**，因为薪资上涨可以维持对服务的需求。

segments.src: - **Central bank communications**, which show how policymakers read the data and whether they see risks to their inflation goal.
segments.tr: - **央行沟通**，这显示了政策制定者如何解读数据，以及他们是否看到了通胀目标面临的风险。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: October's 0.4% increase was a firmer reading than expected, and energy did much of the work.
segments.tr: 10月份0.4%的涨幅比预期的要强劲，能源在其中起了很大作用。

segments.src: With core inflation steady at 0.3%, the report points to ongoing but not accelerating underlying price pressure.
segments.tr: 核心通胀率稳定在0.3%，该报告指出潜在的价格压力仍在持续，但并未加速。

segments.src: A single month is a data point, not a trend, and the inflation debate will turn on whether the coming months confirm or reverse what October showed.
segments.tr: 单月数据只是一个数据点，而非趋势，通胀争论将取决于未来几个月的数据是证实还是反转10月份所显示的情况。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute financial or investment advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成财务或投资建议。

segments.src: Figures are rounded and based on the reported monthly changes; refer to official government statistical releases for complete data.*
segments.tr: 数据经过四舍五入，基于报告的月度变化；完整数据请参考政府官方统计发布。*

hi.title: ऊर्जा ने मुद्रास्फीति को ऊपर धकेला: उपभोक्ता कीमतों में अक्टूबर की 0.4% वृद्धि के भीतर

segments.src: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, a faster pace than most forecasters expected, while core inflation, which leaves out food and energy, held at 0.3%.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता कीमतें अक्टूबर में 0.4% बढ़ीं, जो अधिकांश पूर्वानुमानकर्ताओं की अपेक्षा से तेज़ गति है, जबकि कोर मुद्रास्फीति, जिसमें भोजन और ऊर्जा को शामिल नहीं किया जाता है, 0.3% पर स्थिर रही।

segments.src: The gap between those two numbers points to the main driver of the month: energy.
segments.tr: उन दो आंकड़ों के बीच का अंतर महीने के मुख्य चालक की ओर इशारा करता है: ऊर्जा।

segments.src: This article explains what the headline and core figures mean, which categories fed the increase, and why one strong monthly reading doesn't settle the debate over where inflation is heading.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि हेडलाइन और कोर आंकड़े क्या मायने रखते हैं, किन श्रेणियों ने वृद्धि में योगदान दिया, और क्यों एक मजबूत मासिक रीडिंग इस बहस को खत्म नहीं करती है कि मुद्रास्फीति किस दिशा में जा रही है।

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## एक नज़र में आंकड़े

segments.src: - **Headline consumer prices:** up 0.4% for the month, above forecasts.
segments.tr: - **हेडलाइन उपभोक्ता कीमतें:** महीने के लिए 0.4% ऊपर, पूर्वानुमानों से अधिक।

segments.src: - **Core prices (excluding food and energy):** up 0.3%, unchanged from the prior pace.
segments.tr: - **कोर कीमतें (भोजन और ऊर्जा को छोड़कर):** 0.3% ऊपर, पिछली गति से अपरिवर्तित।

segments.src: - **The difference:** roughly 0.1 percentage point, which is attributable mostly to more volatile categories such as energy.
segments.tr: - **अंतर:** लगभग 0.1 प्रतिशत अंक, जो मुख्य रूप से ऊर्जा जैसी अधिक अस्थिर श्रेणियों के कारण है।

segments.src: A 0.4% monthly gain looks modest, but economists often look at what it implies over a year.
segments.tr: 0.4% की मासिक वृद्धि मामूली दिखती है, लेकिन अर्थशास्त्री अक्सर देखते हैं कि एक वर्ष में इसका क्या अर्थ है।

segments.src: If a 0.4% pace held for twelve months, it would compound to close to 5% annual inflation.
segments.tr: यदि 0.4% की गति बारह महीनों तक बनी रहती है, तो यह लगभग 5% वार्षिक मुद्रास्फीति तक बढ़ जाएगी।

segments.src: That is well above the 2% target the Federal Reserve has set.
segments.tr: यह फेडरल रिजर्व द्वारा निर्धारित 2% के लक्ष्य से काफी ऊपर है।

segments.src: A 0.3% pace compounds to a little under 4%.
segments.tr: 0.3% की गति 4% से थोड़ा कम हो जाती है।

segments.src: That is why even small monthly differences get close attention.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि छोटे मासिक अंतर पर भी पूरा ध्यान दिया जाता है।

segments.src: ## Why Energy Mattered So Much
segments.tr: ## ऊर्जा इतनी महत्वपूर्ण क्यों थी

segments.src: Energy prices are among the most volatile parts of the consumer price index.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा की कीमतें उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक के सबसे अस्थिर हिस्सों में से हैं।

segments.src: Gasoline, electricity, and natural gas can all move sharply from month to month because of weather, refinery activity, seasonal demand, and global supply conditions.
segments.tr: गैसोलीन, बिजली और प्राकृतिक गैस सभी मौसम, रिफाइनरी गतिविधि, मौसमी मांग और वैश्विक आपूर्ति स्थितियों के कारण महीने-दर-महीने तेजी से बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Energy has an outsized effect on headline readings for three reasons:
segments.tr: ऊर्जा का हेडलाइन रीडिंग पर तीन कारणों से बहुत बड़ा प्रभाव पड़ता है:

segments.src: 1. **It is bought often.** Households fill up their tanks and pay utility bills every month, so changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **इसे अक्सर खरीदा जाता है।** परिवार हर महीने अपनी टंकियां भरते हैं और उपयोगिता बिलों का भुगतान करते हैं, इसलिए बदलाव जल्दी महसूस किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **It is volatile.** A swing of several percent in a single month is not unusual, which can move the overall index even when other prices are steady.
segments.tr: 2. **यह अस्थिर है।** एक ही महीने में कई प्रतिशत का उतार-चढ़ाव असामान्य नहीं है, जो अन्य कीमतें स्थिर होने पर भी समग्र सूचकांक को स्थानांतरित कर सकता है।

segments.src: 3. **It feeds into other costs.** Higher fuel and power costs can eventually show up in transportation, shipping, and food prices.
segments.tr: 3. **यह अन्य लागतों में जुड़ जाता है।** उच्च ईंधन और बिजली की लागत अंततः परिवहन, शिपिंग और खाद्य कीमतों में दिखाई दे सकती है।

segments.src: Because the headline index includes energy and the core index does not, an energy-led month tends to lift the first number while leaving the second largely unchanged.
segments.tr: चूंकि हेडलाइन सूचकांक में ऊर्जा शामिल है और कोर सूचकांक में नहीं, इसलिए ऊर्जा के नेतृत्व वाला महीना पहले नंबर को ऊपर उठाने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है जबकि दूसरा काफी हद तक अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

segments.src: That is the pattern seen in October.
segments.tr: अक्टूबर में यही पैटर्न देखा गया है।

segments.src: ## Other Categories in the Mix
segments.tr: ## मिश्रण में अन्य श्रेणियां

segments.src: Energy was not the only contributor.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा एकमात्र योगदानकर्ता नहीं थी।

segments.src: Several other areas typically shape the monthly reading:
segments.tr: कई अन्य क्षेत्र आमतौर पर मासिक रीडिंग को आकार देते हैं:

segments.src: - **Shelter.** Rent and housing-related costs make up the largest single share of the index. They move slowly, but they rarely fall quickly, so they often hold core inflation up.
segments.tr: - **आश्रय (Shelter)।** किराया और आवास संबंधी लागत सूचकांक का सबसे बड़ा एकल हिस्सा बनाती है। वे धीरे-धीरे चलते हैं, लेकिन वे शायद ही कभी जल्दी गिरते हैं, इसलिए वे अक्सर कोर मुद्रास्फीति को ऊपर रखते हैं।

segments.src: - **Food.** Grocery and restaurant prices can add or subtract a few hundredths of a percentage point depending on the month.
segments.tr: - **भोजन।** किराने और रेस्तरां की कीमतें महीने के आधार पर कुछ प्रतिशत अंक जोड़ या घटा सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Services.** Items such as medical care, insurance, and transportation services have been persistent sources of upward pressure in recent years.
segments.tr: - **सेवाएं।** चिकित्सा देखभाल, बीमा और परिवहन सेवाओं जैसी वस्तुएं हाल के वर्षों में ऊपर की ओर दबाव के लगातार स्रोत रही हैं।

segments.src: - **Goods.** Prices for many manufactured goods have been flatter, which helps offset some of the pressure from services.
segments.tr: - **सामान।** कई निर्मित वस्तुओं की कीमतें सपाट रही हैं, जो सेवाओं के दबाव को कुछ हद तक कम करने में मदद करती हैं।

segments.src: A core reading of 0.3% suggests that underlying price growth remains steady rather than accelerating.
segments.tr: 0.3% की कोर रीडिंग बताती है कि अंतर्निहित मूल्य वृद्धि तेज होने के बजाय स्थिर बनी हुई है।

segments.src: It also shows that it hasn't cooled as much as policymakers might prefer.
segments.tr: यह यह भी दिखाता है कि यह उतना ठंडा नहीं हुआ है जितना नीति निर्माता पसंद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why One Hot Month Doesn't Settle the Debate
segments.tr: ## एक गर्म महीना बहस को क्यों नहीं सुलझाता

segments.src: It is tempting to treat each monthly report as a verdict.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक मासिक रिपोर्ट को एक फैसले के रूप में मानना आकर्षक है।

segments.src: Economists are generally more careful, for several reasons.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री आम तौर पर कई कारणों से अधिक सावधान रहते हैं।

segments.src: **Monthly data is noisy.** Seasonal adjustments, weather events, and temporary supply disruptions can all distort a single month.
segments.tr: **मासिक डेटा शोर भरा होता है।** मौसमी समायोजन, मौसम की घटनाएं और अस्थायी आपूर्ति व्यवधान सभी एक महीने को विकृत कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: A figure that looks high may be partly reversed the next month.
segments.tr: जो आंकड़ा अधिक दिखता है, वह अगले महीने आंशिक रूप से उलट सकता है।

segments.src: **Energy can reverse.** If the increase came from a short-term spike in fuel or utility costs, prices may ease later.
segments.tr: **ऊर्जा उलट सकती है।** यदि वृद्धि ईंधन या उपयोगिता लागत में अल्पकालिक उछाल से आई है, तो कीमतें बाद में कम हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: The effect on headline inflation would then fade.
segments.tr: हेडलाइन मुद्रास्फीति पर प्रभाव तब फीका पड़ जाएगा।

segments.src: **Core is the steadier guide.** Because core inflation strips out the most volatile items, many analysts consider it a better signal of where prices are going over the next several months.
segments.tr: **कोर अधिक स्थिर मार्गदर्शक है।** चूंकि कोर मुद्रास्फीति सबसे अस्थिर वस्तुओं को हटा देती है, इसलिए कई विश्लेषक इसे इस बात का बेहतर संकेत मानते हैं कि अगले कई महीनों में कीमतें कहां जा रही हैं।

segments.src: A steady 0.3% is neither a clear sign of re-acceleration nor of a sustained cooling.
segments.tr: 0.3% की स्थिर दर न तो पुन: त्वरण का स्पष्ट संकेत है और न ही निरंतर शीतलन का।

segments.src: **Trends matter more than points.** Analysts often look at three-month and six-month averages, as well as year-over-year changes, to see through temporary swings.
segments.tr: **रुझान बिंदुओं से अधिक मायने रखते हैं।** विश्लेषक अक्सर अस्थायी उतार-चढ़ाव को देखने के लिए तीन महीने और छह महीने के औसत, साथ ही साल-दर-साल परिवर्तनों को देखते हैं।

segments.src: One reading above forecasts does not establish a new trend, just as one below forecasts would not have ended the debate.
segments.tr: पूर्वानुमानों से ऊपर की एक रीडिंग एक नया रुझान स्थापित नहीं करती है, ठीक वैसे ही जैसे पूर्वानुमानों से नीचे की एक रीडिंग बहस को समाप्त नहीं करती।

segments.src: **Revisions and surveys can change the picture.** Government statistical agencies sometimes revise earlier figures, and surveys of consumers and businesses offer additional context about price expectations.
segments.tr: **संशोधन और सर्वेक्षण तस्वीर बदल सकते हैं।** सरकारी सांख्यिकीय एजेंसियां कभी-कभी पहले के आंकड़ों को संशोधित करती हैं, और उपभोक्ताओं और व्यवसायों के सर्वेक्षण मूल्य अपेक्षाओं के बारे में अतिरिक्त संदर्भ प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What It Means for Households
segments.tr: ## परिवारों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: For most households, the practical effect of an energy-led increase shows up at the gas pump and on utility bills.
segments.tr: अधिकांश परिवारों के लिए, ऊर्जा के नेतृत्व वाली वृद्धि का व्यावहारिक प्रभाव गैस पंप और उपयोगिता बिलों पर दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: Those costs are hard to avoid, so they can feel larger than the headline number suggests.
segments.tr: उन लागतों से बचना मुश्किल है, इसलिए वे हेडलाइन संख्या के सुझाव से अधिक महसूस कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Higher energy costs may also leave less room in budgets for other spending.
segments.tr: उच्च ऊर्जा लागत अन्य खर्चों के लिए बजट में कम जगह छोड़ सकती है।

segments.src: Some general points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: ध्यान रखने योग्य कुछ सामान्य बिंदु:

segments.src: - Track your own spending categories rather than relying only on national averages. Your personal inflation rate depends on what you buy.
segments.tr: - केवल राष्ट्रीय औसत पर भरोसा करने के बजाय अपनी खुद की खर्च श्रेणियों को ट्रैक करें। आपकी व्यक्तिगत मुद्रास्फीति दर इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि आप क्या खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: - Seasonal changes in heating and cooling costs can be planned for ahead of time.
segments.tr: - हीटिंग और कूलिंग लागत में मौसमी बदलाव की योजना पहले से बनाई जा सकती है।

segments.src: - Short-term price moves in energy often don't last, so large financial decisions made on one month's data carry more risk.
segments.tr: - ऊर्जा में अल्पकालिक मूल्य चालें अक्सर नहीं टिकती हैं, इसलिए एक महीने के डेटा पर लिए गए बड़े वित्तीय निर्णय अधिक जोखिम उठाते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: Several indicators will help show whether October was a one-off or part of a broader pattern:
segments.tr: कई संकेतक यह दिखाने में मदद करेंगे कि क्या अक्टूबर एक बार की घटना थी या व्यापक पैटर्न का हिस्सा:

segments.src: - **Next month's CPI report**, especially the core figure and the energy component.
segments.tr: - **अगले महीने की CPI रिपोर्ट**, विशेष रूप से कोर आंकड़ा और ऊर्जा घटक।

segments.src: - **Wholesale and producer prices**, which can signal pressure that has not yet reached consumers.
segments.tr: - **थोक और उत्पादक कीमतें**, जो उस दबाव का संकेत दे सकती हैं जो अभी तक उपभोक्ताओं तक नहीं पहुंचा है।

segments.src: - **Wage growth**, since rising pay can sustain demand for services.
segments.tr: - **वेतन वृद्धि**, क्योंकि बढ़ता वेतन सेवाओं के लिए मांग को बनाए रख सकता है।

segments.src: - **Central bank communications**, which show how policymakers read the data and whether they see risks to their inflation goal.
segments.tr: - **केंद्रीय बैंक संचार**, जो दिखाते हैं कि नीति निर्माता डेटा को कैसे पढ़ते हैं और क्या वे अपने मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य के लिए जोखिम देखते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: October's 0.4% increase was a firmer reading than expected, and energy did much of the work.
segments.tr: अक्टूबर की 0.4% की वृद्धि अपेक्षा से अधिक मजबूत रीडिंग थी, और ऊर्जा ने अधिकांश काम किया।

segments.src: With core inflation steady at 0.3%, the report points to ongoing but not accelerating underlying price pressure.
segments.tr: कोर मुद्रास्फीति के 0.3% पर स्थिर रहने के साथ, रिपोर्ट चल रहे लेकिन तेज नहीं हो रहे अंतर्निहित मूल्य दबाव की ओर इशारा करती है।

segments.src: A single month is a data point, not a trend, and the inflation debate will turn on whether the coming months confirm or reverse what October showed.
segments.tr: एक महीना एक डेटा बिंदु है, रुझान नहीं, और मुद्रास्फीति की बहस इस बात पर निर्भर करेगी कि क्या आने वाले महीने अक्टूबर में दिखाए गए आंकड़ों की पुष्टि करते हैं या उलट देते हैं।

es.title: La energía impulsa la inflación al alza: dentro del repunte del 0,4% de los precios al consumidor en octubre

segments.src: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, a faster pace than most forecasters expected, while core inflation, which leaves out food and energy, held at 0.3%.
segments.tr: Los precios al consumidor subieron un 0,4% en octubre, un ritmo más rápido de lo que esperaban la mayoría de los pronosticadores, mientras que la inflación subyacente, que excluye los alimentos y la energía, se mantuvo en el 0,3%.

segments.src: The gap between those two numbers points to the main driver of the month: energy.
segments.tr: La brecha entre esos dos números señala al principal impulsor del mes: la energía.

segments.src: This article explains what the headline and core figures mean, which categories fed the increase, and why one strong monthly reading doesn't settle the debate over where inflation is heading.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica qué significan las cifras general y subyacente, qué categorías alimentaron el aumento y por qué una lectura mensual sólida no resuelve el debate sobre hacia dónde se dirige la inflación.

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## Las cifras de un vistazo

segments.src: - **Headline consumer prices:** up 0.4% for the month, above forecasts.
segments.tr: - **Precios al consumidor generales:** subieron un 0,4% en el mes, por encima de los pronósticos.

segments.src: - **Core prices (excluding food and energy):** up 0.3%, unchanged from the prior pace.
segments.tr: - **Precios subyacentes (excluyendo alimentos y energía):** subieron un 0,3%, sin cambios con respecto al ritmo anterior.

segments.src: - **The difference:** roughly 0.1 percentage point, which is attributable mostly to more volatile categories such as energy.
segments.tr: - **La diferencia:** aproximadamente 0,1 puntos porcentuales, lo cual se atribuye principalmente a categorías más volátiles como la energía.

segments.src: A 0.4% monthly gain looks modest, but economists often look at what it implies over a year.
segments.tr: Una ganancia mensual del 0,4% parece modesta, pero los economistas a menudo analizan lo que implica a lo largo de un año.

segments.src: If a 0.4% pace held for twelve months, it would compound to close to 5% annual inflation.
segments.tr: Si un ritmo del 0,4% se mantuviera durante doce meses, se compondría hasta alcanzar casi un 5% de inflación anual.

segments.src: That is well above the 2% target the Federal Reserve has set.
segments.tr: Eso está muy por encima del objetivo del 2% que ha fijado la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: A 0.3% pace compounds to a little under 4%.
segments.tr: Un ritmo del 0,3% se compone a un poco menos del 4%.

segments.src: That is why even small monthly differences get close attention.
segments.tr: Por eso incluso las pequeñas diferencias mensuales reciben mucha atención.

segments.src: ## Why Energy Mattered So Much
segments.tr: ## Por qué la energía importó tanto

segments.src: Energy prices are among the most volatile parts of the consumer price index.
segments.tr: Los precios de la energía se encuentran entre las partes más volátiles del índice de precios al consumidor.

segments.src: Gasoline, electricity, and natural gas can all move sharply from month to month because of weather, refinery activity, seasonal demand, and global supply conditions.
segments.tr: La gasolina, la electricidad y el gas natural pueden moverse bruscamente de un mes a otro debido al clima, la actividad de las refinerías, la demanda estacional y las condiciones del suministro global.

segments.src: Energy has an outsized effect on headline readings for three reasons:
segments.tr: La energía tiene un efecto desproporcionado en las lecturas generales por tres razones:

segments.src: 1. **It is bought often.** Households fill up their tanks and pay utility bills every month, so changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **Se compra a menudo.** Los hogares llenan sus tanques y pagan las facturas de servicios públicos todos los meses, por lo que los cambios se sienten rápidamente.

segments.src: 2. **It is volatile.** A swing of several percent in a single month is not unusual, which can move the overall index even when other prices are steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Es volátil.** Una oscilación de varios puntos porcentuales en un solo mes no es inusual, lo que puede mover el índice general incluso cuando otros precios están estables.

segments.src: 3. **It feeds into other costs.** Higher fuel and power costs can eventually show up in transportation, shipping, and food prices.
segments.tr: 3. **Se traslada a otros costos.** Los mayores costos de combustible y energía pueden terminar reflejándose en el transporte, el envío y los precios de los alimentos.

segments.src: Because the headline index includes energy and the core index does not, an energy-led month tends to lift the first number while leaving the second largely unchanged.
segments.tr: Debido a que el índice general incluye la energía y el índice subyacente no, un mes impulsado por la energía tiende a elevar la primera cifra mientras deja la segunda en gran medida sin cambios.

segments.src: That is the pattern seen in October.
segments.tr: Ese es el patrón observado en octubre.

segments.src: ## Other Categories in the Mix
segments.tr: ## Otras categorías en la mezcla

segments.src: Energy was not the only contributor.
segments.tr: La energía no fue el único contribuyente.

segments.src: Several other areas typically shape the monthly reading:
segments.tr: Varias otras áreas suelen dar forma a la lectura mensual:

segments.src: - **Shelter.** Rent and housing-related costs make up the largest single share of the index. They move slowly, but they rarely fall quickly, so they often hold core inflation up.
segments.tr: - **Vivienda.** El alquiler y los costos relacionados con la vivienda representan la mayor cuota individual del índice. Se mueven lentamente, pero rara vez bajan rápido, por lo que a menudo mantienen elevada la inflación subyacente.

segments.src: - **Food.** Grocery and restaurant prices can add or subtract a few hundredths of a percentage point depending on the month.
segments.tr: - **Alimentos.** Los precios del supermercado y de los restaurantes pueden sumar o restar algunas centésimas de punto porcentual según el mes.

segments.src: - **Services.** Items such as medical care, insurance, and transportation services have been persistent sources of upward pressure in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Servicios.** Artículos como la atención médica, los seguros y los servicios de transporte han sido fuentes persistentes de presión al alza en los últimos años.

segments.src: - **Goods.** Prices for many manufactured goods have been flatter, which helps offset some of the pressure from services.
segments.tr: - **Bienes.** Los precios de muchos bienes manufacturados han sido más estables, lo que ayuda a compensar parte de la presión de los servicios.

segments.src: A core reading of 0.3% suggests that underlying price growth remains steady rather than accelerating.
segments.tr: Una lectura subyacente del 0,3% sugiere que el crecimiento subyacente de los precios se mantiene estable en lugar de acelerarse.

segments.src: It also shows that it hasn't cooled as much as policymakers might prefer.
segments.tr: También muestra que no se ha enfriado tanto como preferirían los responsables de las políticas.

segments.src: ## Why One Hot Month Doesn't Settle the Debate
segments.tr: ## Por qué un mes fuerte no resuelve el debate

segments.src: It is tempting to treat each monthly report as a verdict.
segments.tr: Es tentador tratar cada informe mensual como un veredicto definitivo.

segments.src: Economists are generally more careful, for several reasons.
segments.tr: Los economistas son generalmente más cautelosos, por varias razones.

segments.src: **Monthly data is noisy.** Seasonal adjustments, weather events, and temporary supply disruptions can all distort a single month.
segments.tr: **Los datos mensuales son ruidosos.** Los ajustes estacionales, los eventos climáticos y las interrupciones temporales del suministro pueden distorsionar un solo mes.

segments.src: A figure that looks high may be partly reversed the next month.
segments.tr: Una cifra que parece alta puede revertirse en parte el mes siguiente.

segments.src: **Energy can reverse.** If the increase came from a short-term spike in fuel or utility costs, prices may ease later.
segments.tr: **La energía puede revertirse.** Si el aumento provino de un pico a corto plazo en los costos de combustible o servicios públicos, los precios pueden moderarse más adelante.

segments.src: The effect on headline inflation would then fade.
segments.tr: El efecto sobre la inflación general se desvanecería entonces.

segments.src: **Core is the steadier guide.** Because core inflation strips out the most volatile items, many analysts consider it a better signal of where prices are going over the next several months.
segments.tr: **La inflación subyacente es la guía más constante.** Debido a que la inflación subyacente elimina los elementos más volátiles, muchos analistas la consideran una mejor señal de hacia dónde se dirigen los precios en los próximos meses.

segments.src: A steady 0.3% is neither a clear sign of re-acceleration nor of a sustained cooling.
segments.tr: Un 0,3% constante no es una señal clara de reaceleración ni de un enfriamiento sostenido.

segments.src: **Trends matter more than points.** Analysts often look at three-month and six-month averages, as well as year-over-year changes, to see through temporary swings.
segments.tr: **Las tendencias importan más que los puntos aislados.** Los analistas a menudo observan los promedios de tres y seis meses, así como los cambios interanuales, para ver más allá de las oscilaciones temporales.

segments.src: One reading above forecasts does not establish a new trend, just as one below forecasts would not have ended the debate.
segments.tr: Una lectura por encima de los pronósticos no establece una nueva tendencia, del mismo modo que una por debajo de los pronósticos no habría puesto fin al debate.

segments.src: **Revisions and surveys can change the picture.** Government statistical agencies sometimes revise earlier figures, and surveys of consumers and businesses offer additional context about price expectations.
segments.tr: **Las revisiones y encuestas pueden cambiar el panorama.** Las agencias de estadística gubernamentales a veces revisan cifras anteriores, y las encuestas a consumidores y empresas ofrecen contexto adicional sobre las expectativas de precios.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Households
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los hogares

segments.src: For most households, the practical effect of an energy-led increase shows up at the gas pump and on utility bills.
segments.tr: Para la mayoría de los hogares, el efecto práctico de un aumento impulsado por la energía se nota en la gasolinera y en las facturas de servicios públicos.

segments.src: Those costs are hard to avoid, so they can feel larger than the headline number suggests.
segments.tr: Esos costos son difíciles de evitar, por lo que pueden sentirse mayores de lo que sugiere la cifra general.

segments.src: Higher energy costs may also leave less room in budgets for other spending.
segments.tr: Los mayores costos de energía también pueden dejar menos espacio en los presupuestos para otros gastos.

segments.src: Some general points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: Algunos puntos generales a tener en cuenta:

segments.src: - Track your own spending categories rather than relying only on national averages. Your personal inflation rate depends on what you buy.
segments.tr: - Haga un seguimiento de sus propias categorías de gasto en lugar de confiar solo en los promedios nacionales. Su tasa de inflación personal depende de lo que compre.

segments.src: - Seasonal changes in heating and cooling costs can be planned for ahead of time.
segments.tr: - Los cambios estacionales en los costos de calefacción y refrigeración se pueden planificar con anticipación.

segments.src: - Short-term price moves in energy often don't last, so large financial decisions made on one month's data carry more risk.
segments.tr: - Los movimientos de precios a corto plazo en la energía a menudo no duran, por lo que las decisiones financieras grandes basadas en los datos de un solo mes conllevan más riesgo.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: Several indicators will help show whether October was a one-off or part of a broader pattern:
segments.tr: Varios indicadores ayudarán a mostrar si octubre fue un hecho aislado o parte de un patrón más amplio:

segments.src: - **Next month's CPI report**, especially the core figure and the energy component.
segments.tr: - **El informe del IPC del próximo mes**, especialmente la cifra subyacente y el componente de energía.

segments.src: - **Wholesale and producer prices**, which can signal pressure that has not yet reached consumers.
segments.tr: - **Los precios al por mayor y de producción**, que pueden señalar presiones que aún no han llegado a los consumidores.

segments.src: - **Wage growth**, since rising pay can sustain demand for services.
segments.tr: - **El crecimiento salarial**, ya que el aumento de los sueldos puede sostener la demanda de servicios.

segments.src: - **Central bank communications**, which show how policymakers read the data and whether they see risks to their inflation goal.
segments.tr: - **Las comunicaciones del banco central**, que muestran cómo los responsables de las políticas leen los datos y si ven riesgos para su objetivo de inflación.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: October's 0.4% increase was a firmer reading than expected, and energy did much of the work.
segments.tr: El aumento del 0,4% en octubre fue una lectura más firme de lo esperado, y la energía hizo gran parte del trabajo.

segments.src: With core inflation steady at 0.3%, the report points to ongoing but not accelerating underlying price pressure.
segments.tr: Con la inflación subyacente estable en el 0,3%, el informe señala una presión subyacente de precios continua pero no acelerada.

segments.src: A single month is a data point, not a trend, and the inflation debate will turn on whether the coming months confirm or reverse what October showed.
segments.tr: Un solo mes es un punto de datos, no una tendencia, y el debate sobre la inflación dependerá de si los próximos meses confirman o revierten lo que mostró octubre.

ar.title: الطاقة تدفع التضخم للارتفاع: نظرة على قفزة أسعار المستهلك بنسبة 0.4% في أكتوبر

segments.tr: ارتفعت أسعار المستهلك بنسبة 0.4% في أكتوبر، وهي وتيرة أسرع مما توقعه معظم المحللين، في حين استقر التضخم الأساسي، الذي يستثني الغذاء والطاقة، عند 0.3%.

segments.src: The gap between those two numbers points to the main driver of the month: energy.
segments.tr: تشير الفجوة بين هذين الرقمين إلى المحرك الرئيسي لهذا الشهر: الطاقة.

segments.src: This article explains what the headline and core figures mean, which categories fed the increase, and why one strong monthly reading doesn't settle the debate over where inflation is heading.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال معنى الأرقام الرئيسية والأساسية، والفئات التي ساهمت في الزيادة، ولماذا لا تحسم قراءة شهرية واحدة قوية الجدل حول اتجاه التضخم.

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## نظرة سريعة على الأرقام

segments.src: - **Headline consumer prices:** up 0.4% for the month, above forecasts.
segments.tr: - **أسعار المستهلك الرئيسية:** ارتفعت بنسبة 0.4% خلال الشهر، متجاوزة التوقعات.

segments.src: - **Core prices (excluding food and energy):** up 0.3%, unchanged from the prior pace.
segments.tr: - **الأسعار الأساسية (باستثناء الغذاء والطاقة):** ارتفعت بنسبة 0.3%، دون تغيير عن الوتيرة السابقة.

segments.src: - **The difference:** roughly 0.1 percentage point, which is attributable mostly to more volatile categories such as energy.
segments.tr: - **الفرق:** حوالي 0.1 نقطة مئوية، وهو ما يعزى في الغالب إلى الفئات الأكثر تقلباً مثل الطاقة.

segments.src: A 0.4% monthly gain looks modest, but economists often look at what it implies over a year.
segments.tr: تبدو الزيادة الشهرية بنسبة 0.4% متواضعة، لكن الاقتصاديين غالباً ما ينظرون إلى ما تعنيه على مدار عام.

segments.src: If a 0.4% pace held for twelve months, it would compound to close to 5% annual inflation.
segments.tr: إذا استمرت وتيرة 0.4% لمدة اثني عشر شهراً، فسيؤدي ذلك إلى تضخم سنوي يقترب من 5%.

segments.src: That is well above the 2% target the Federal Reserve has set.
segments.tr: وهذا أعلى بكثير من هدف 2% الذي حدده الاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: A 0.3% pace compounds to a little under 4%.
segments.tr: وتيرة 0.3% تعادل ما يقل قليلاً عن 4%.

segments.src: That is why even small monthly differences get close attention.
segments.tr: ولهذا السبب تحظى الاختلافات الشهرية الصغيرة باهتمام وثيق.

segments.src: ## Why Energy Mattered So Much
segments.tr: ## لماذا كانت الطاقة مهمة جداً

segments.src: Energy prices are among the most volatile parts of the consumer price index.
segments.tr: تعد أسعار الطاقة من بين أكثر أجزاء مؤشر أسعار المستهلك تقلباً.

segments.src: Gasoline, electricity, and natural gas can all move sharply from month to month because of weather, refinery activity, seasonal demand, and global supply conditions.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتحرك أسعار البنزين والكهرباء والغاز الطبيعي بشكل حاد من شهر لآخر بسبب الطقس، ونشاط المصافي، والطلب الموسمي، وظروف الإمداد العالمية.

segments.src: Energy has an outsized effect on headline readings for three reasons:
segments.tr: للطاقة تأثير كبير على القراءات الرئيسية لثلاثة أسباب:

segments.src: 1. **It is bought often.** Households fill up their tanks and pay utility bills every month, so changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **يتم شراؤها بشكل متكرر.** تملأ الأسر خزانات وقود سياراتها وتدفع فواتير الخدمات كل شهر، لذا يتم الشعور بالتغييرات بسرعة.

segments.src: 2. **It is volatile.** A swing of several percent in a single month is not unusual, which can move the overall index even when other prices are steady.
segments.tr: 2. **إنها متقلبة.** ليس من غير المعتاد حدوث تأرجح بنسبة عدة بالمائة في شهر واحد، مما قد يحرك المؤشر العام حتى عندما تكون الأسعار الأخرى مستقرة.

segments.src: 3. **It feeds into other costs.** Higher fuel and power costs can eventually show up in transportation, shipping, and food prices.
segments.tr: 3. **تؤثر على تكاليف أخرى.** يمكن أن تظهر تكاليف الوقود والطاقة المرتفعة في النهاية في أسعار النقل والشحن والغذاء.

segments.src: Because the headline index includes energy and the core index does not, an energy-led month tends to lift the first number while leaving the second largely unchanged.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن المؤشر الرئيسي يتضمن الطاقة بينما لا يتضمنها المؤشر الأساسي، فإن الشهر الذي تقوده الطاقة يميل إلى رفع الرقم الأول مع ترك الثاني دون تغيير إلى حد كبير.

segments.src: That is the pattern seen in October.
segments.tr: هذا هو النمط الذي شوهد في أكتوبر.

segments.src: ## Other Categories in the Mix
segments.tr: ## فئات أخرى في المزيج

segments.src: Energy was not the only contributor.
segments.tr: لم تكن الطاقة هي المساهم الوحيد.

segments.src: Several other areas typically shape the monthly reading:
segments.tr: هناك عدة مجالات أخرى تشكل عادة القراءة الشهرية:

segments.src: - **Shelter.** Rent and housing-related costs make up the largest single share of the index. They move slowly, but they rarely fall quickly, so they often hold core inflation up.
segments.tr: - **المأوى.** تشكل تكاليف الإيجار والسكن أكبر حصة فردية في المؤشر. إنها تتحرك ببطء، لكنها نادراً ما تنخفض بسرعة، لذا فهي غالباً ما تبقي التضخم الأساسي مرتفعاً.

segments.src: - **Food.** Grocery and restaurant prices can add or subtract a few hundredths of a percentage point depending on the month.
segments.tr: - **الغذاء.** يمكن لأسعار البقالة والمطاعم أن تضيف أو تطرح بضعة أجزاء من المائة من النقطة المئوية اعتماداً على الشهر.

segments.src: - **Services.** Items such as medical care, insurance, and transportation services have been persistent sources of upward pressure in recent years.
segments.tr: - **الخدمات.** كانت بنود مثل الرعاية الطبية والتأمين وخدمات النقل مصادر مستمرة للضغط التصاعدي في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: - **Goods.** Prices for many manufactured goods have been flatter, which helps offset some of the pressure from services.
segments.tr: - **السلع.** كانت أسعار العديد من السلع المصنعة أكثر استقراراً، مما يساعد في تعويض بعض الضغوط الناتجة عن الخدمات.

segments.src: A core reading of 0.3% suggests that underlying price growth remains steady rather than accelerating.
segments.tr: تشير القراءة الأساسية بنسبة 0.3% إلى أن نمو الأسعار الأساسي لا يزال مستقراً بدلاً من التسارع.

segments.src: It also shows that it hasn't cooled as much as policymakers might prefer.
segments.tr: كما أنها تظهر أنه لم يبرد بالقدر الذي قد يفضله صناع السياسات.

segments.src: ## Why One Hot Month Doesn't Settle the Debate
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا يحسم شهر واحد ساخن الجدل

segments.src: It is tempting to treat each monthly report as a verdict.
segments.tr: من المغري التعامل مع كل تقرير شهري كحكم نهائي.

segments.src: Economists are generally more careful, for several reasons.
segments.tr: الاقتصاديون أكثر حذراً بشكل عام، لعدة أسباب.

segments.src: **Monthly data is noisy.** Seasonal adjustments, weather events, and temporary supply disruptions can all distort a single month.
segments.tr: **البيانات الشهرية مشوشة.** يمكن للتعديلات الموسمية، وأحداث الطقس، واضطرابات الإمداد المؤقتة أن تشوه شهراً واحداً.

segments.src: A figure that looks high may be partly reversed the next month.
segments.tr: الرقم الذي يبدو مرتفعاً قد يتم عكسه جزئياً في الشهر التالي.

segments.src: **Energy can reverse.** If the increase came from a short-term spike in fuel or utility costs, prices may ease later.
segments.tr: **يمكن أن تنعكس الطاقة.** إذا جاءت الزيادة من ارتفاع قصير الأجل في تكاليف الوقود أو المرافق، فقد تنخفض الأسعار لاحقاً.

segments.src: The effect on headline inflation would then fade.
segments.tr: عندها سيتلاشى التأثير على التضخم الرئيسي.

segments.src: **Core is the steadier guide.** Because core inflation strips out the most volatile items, many analysts consider it a better signal of where prices are going over the next several months.
segments.tr: **الأساسي هو الدليل الأكثر استقراراً.** نظراً لأن التضخم الأساسي يستبعد البنود الأكثر تقلباً، يعتبره العديد من المحللين إشارة أفضل لاتجاه الأسعار على مدى الأشهر العديدة القادمة.

segments.src: A steady 0.3% is neither a clear sign of re-acceleration nor of a sustained cooling.
segments.tr: النسبة المستقرة عند 0.3% ليست علامة واضحة على إعادة التسارع ولا على التبريد المستدام.

segments.src: **Trends matter more than points.** Analysts often look at three-month and six-month averages, as well as year-over-year changes, to see through temporary swings.
segments.tr: **الاتجاهات أهم من النقاط الفردية.** غالباً ما ينظر المحللون إلى متوسطات ثلاثة أشهر وستة أشهر، بالإضافة إلى التغيرات على أساس سنوي، لرؤية ما وراء التقلبات المؤقتة.

segments.src: One reading above forecasts does not establish a new trend, just as one below forecasts would not have ended the debate.
segments.tr: قراءة واحدة أعلى من التوقعات لا تؤسس لاتجاه جديد، تماماً كما أن قراءة واحدة أقل من التوقعات لم تكن لتنهي الجدل.

segments.src: **Revisions and surveys can change the picture.** Government statistical agencies sometimes revise earlier figures, and surveys of consumers and businesses offer additional context about price expectations.
segments.tr: **المراجعات والاستطلاعات يمكن أن تغير الصورة.** تقوم الوكالات الإحصائية الحكومية أحياناً بمراجعة الأرقام السابقة، وتقدم استطلاعات المستهلكين والشركات سياقاً إضافياً حول توقعات الأسعار.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Households
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للأسر

segments.src: For most households, the practical effect of an energy-led increase shows up at the gas pump and on utility bills.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لمعظم الأسر، يظهر التأثير العملي للزيادة التي تقودها الطاقة عند محطة الوقود وفي فواتير الخدمات.

segments.src: Those costs are hard to avoid, so they can feel larger than the headline number suggests.
segments.tr: من الصعب تجنب هذه التكاليف، لذا يمكن أن تبدو أكبر مما يشير إليه الرقم الرئيسي.

segments.src: Higher energy costs may also leave less room in budgets for other spending.
segments.tr: قد تترك تكاليف الطاقة المرتفعة أيضاً مساحة أقل في الميزانيات للإنفاق الآخر.

segments.src: Some general points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: بعض النقاط العامة التي يجب وضعها في الاعتبار:

segments.src: - Track your own spending categories rather than relying only on national averages. Your personal inflation rate depends on what you buy.
segments.tr: - تتبع فئات إنفاقك الخاصة بدلاً من الاعتماد فقط على المتوسطات الوطنية. يعتمد معدل التضخم الشخصي الخاص بك على ما تشتريه.

segments.src: - Seasonal changes in heating and cooling costs can be planned for ahead of time.
segments.tr: - يمكن التخطيط للتغيرات الموسمية في تكاليف التدفئة والتبريد مسبقاً.

segments.src: - Short-term price moves in energy often don't last, so large financial decisions made on one month's data carry more risk.
segments.tr: - غالباً لا تدوم تحركات الأسعار قصيرة الأجل في الطاقة، لذا فإن القرارات المالية الكبيرة التي تتخذ بناءً على بيانات شهر واحد تحمل مخاطر أكبر.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: Several indicators will help show whether October was a one-off or part of a broader pattern:
segments.tr: ستساعد عدة مؤشرات في توضيح ما إذا كان شهر أكتوبر حالة استثنائية أم جزءاً من نمط أوسع:

segments.src: - **Next month's CPI report**, especially the core figure and the energy component.
segments.tr: - **تقرير مؤشر أسعار المستهلك للشهر المقبل**، وخاصة الرقم الأساسي ومكون الطاقة.

segments.src: - **Wholesale and producer prices**, which can signal pressure that has not yet reached consumers.
segments.tr: - **أسعار الجملة والمنتجين**، والتي يمكن أن تشير إلى ضغوط لم تصل بعد إلى المستهلكين.

segments.src: - **Wage growth**, since rising pay can sustain demand for services.
segments.tr: - **نمو الأجور**، حيث يمكن أن يؤدي ارتفاع الأجور إلى استدامة الطلب على الخدمات.

segments.src: - **Central bank communications**, which show how policymakers read the data and whether they see risks to their inflation goal.
segments.tr: - **اتصالات البنك المركزي**، والتي تظهر كيف يقرأ صناع السياسات البيانات وما إذا كانوا يرون مخاطر على هدف التضخم الخاص بهم.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: October's 0.4% increase was a firmer reading than expected, and energy did much of the work.
segments.tr: كانت زيادة أكتوبر بنسبة 0.4% قراءة أقوى من المتوقع، وكانت الطاقة هي المحرك الرئيسي.

segments.src: With core inflation steady at 0.3%, the report points to ongoing but not accelerating underlying price pressure.
segments.tr: مع استقرار التضخم الأساسي عند 0.3%، يشير التقرير إلى ضغوط أسعار أساسية مستمرة ولكنها غير متسارعة.

segments.src: A single month is a data point, not a trend, and the inflation debate will turn on whether the coming months confirm or reverse what October showed.
segments.tr: شهر واحد هو نقطة بيانات، وليس اتجاهاً، وسيعتمد جدل التضخم على ما إذا كانت الأشهر القادمة ستؤكد أو تعكس ما أظهره أكتوبر.

fr.title: L'énergie pousse l'inflation à la hausse : analyse du bond de 0,4 % des prix à la consommation en octobre

segments.src: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, a faster pace than most forecasters expected, while core inflation, which leaves out food and energy, held at 0.3%.
segments.tr: Les prix à la consommation ont augmenté de 0,4 % en octobre, un rythme plus rapide que ce que la plupart des prévisionnistes anticipaient, tandis que l'inflation sous-jacente, qui exclut l'alimentation et l'énergie, s'est maintenue à 0,3 %.

segments.src: The gap between those two numbers points to the main driver of the month: energy.
segments.tr: L'écart entre ces deux chiffres met en lumière le principal moteur du mois : l'énergie.

segments.src: This article explains what the headline and core figures mean, which categories fed the increase, and why one strong monthly reading doesn't settle the debate over where inflation is heading.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce que signifient les chiffres globaux et sous-jacents, quelles catégories ont alimenté cette hausse, et pourquoi une seule lecture mensuelle solide ne clôt pas le débat sur l'évolution future de l'inflation.

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## Les chiffres en un coup d'œil

segments.src: - **Headline consumer prices:** up 0.4% for the month, above forecasts.
segments.tr: - **Prix à la consommation globaux :** en hausse de 0,4 % sur le mois, au-dessus des prévisions.

segments.src: - **Core prices (excluding food and energy):** up 0.3%, unchanged from the prior pace.
segments.tr: - **Prix sous-jacents (hors alimentation et énergie) :** en hausse de 0,3 %, inchangés par rapport au rythme précédent.

segments.src: - **The difference:** roughly 0.1 percentage point, which is attributable mostly to more volatile categories such as energy.
segments.tr: - **La différence :** environ 0,1 point de pourcentage, attribuable principalement à des catégories plus volatiles telles que l'énergie.

segments.src: A 0.4% monthly gain looks modest, but economists often look at what it implies over a year.
segments.tr: Une hausse mensuelle de 0,4 % semble modeste, mais les économistes examinent souvent ce qu'elle implique sur une année.

segments.src: If a 0.4% pace held for twelve months, it would compound to close to 5% annual inflation.
segments.tr: Si un rythme de 0,4 % se maintenait pendant douze mois, cela représenterait une inflation annualisée proche de 5 %.

segments.src: That is well above the 2% target the Federal Reserve has set.
segments.tr: C'est bien au-dessus de l'objectif de 2 % fixé par la Réserve fédérale.

segments.src: A 0.3% pace compounds to a little under 4%.
segments.tr: Un rythme de 0,3 % équivaut à un peu moins de 4 % en taux annualisé.

segments.src: That is why even small monthly differences get close attention.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi même de petites différences mensuelles retiennent vivement l'attention.

segments.src: ## Why Energy Mattered So Much
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'énergie a tant compté

segments.src: Energy prices are among the most volatile parts of the consumer price index.
segments.tr: Les prix de l'énergie figurent parmi les composantes les plus volatiles de l'indice des prix à la consommation.

segments.src: Gasoline, electricity, and natural gas can all move sharply from month to month because of weather, refinery activity, seasonal demand, and global supply conditions.
segments.tr: L'essence, l'électricité et le gaz naturel peuvent tous fluctuer brusquement d'un mois à l'autre en raison de la météo, de l'activité des raffineries, de la demande saisonnière et des conditions d'approvisionnement mondiales.

segments.src: Energy has an outsized effect on headline readings for three reasons:
segments.tr: L'énergie exerce un effet disproportionné sur les chiffres globaux pour trois raisons :

segments.src: 1. **It is bought often.** Households fill up their tanks and pay utility bills every month, so changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: 1. **Elle est achetée fréquemment.** Les ménages font le plein et paient leurs factures d'énergie chaque mois, de sorte que les changements se font sentir rapidement.

segments.src: 2. **It is volatile.** A swing of several percent in a single month is not unusual, which can move the overall index even when other prices are steady.
segments.tr: 2. **Elle est volatile.** Une variation de plusieurs pourcents en un seul mois n'est pas rare, ce qui peut faire bouger l'indice global même lorsque les autres prix sont stables.

segments.src: 3. **It feeds into other costs.** Higher fuel and power costs can eventually show up in transportation, shipping, and food prices.
segments.tr: 3. **Elle se répercute sur d'autres coûts.** Des coûts de carburant et d'électricité plus élevés peuvent finir par se refléter dans les prix du transport, de l'expédition et de l'alimentation.

segments.src: Because the headline index includes energy and the core index does not, an energy-led month tends to lift the first number while leaving the second largely unchanged.
segments.tr: Étant donné que l'indice global inclut l'énergie et que l'indice sous-jacent ne l'inclut pas, un mois dominé par l'énergie a tendance à faire grimper le premier chiffre tout en laissant le second largement inchangé.

segments.src: That is the pattern seen in October.
segments.tr: C'est le schéma observé en octobre.

segments.src: ## Other Categories in the Mix
segments.tr: ## Les autres catégories dans le tableau

segments.src: Energy was not the only contributor.
segments.tr: L'énergie n'a pas été la seule contributrice.

segments.src: Several other areas typically shape the monthly reading:
segments.tr: Plusieurs autres secteurs façonnent généralement la lecture mensuelle :

segments.src: - **Shelter.** Rent and housing-related costs make up the largest single share of the index. They move slowly, but they rarely fall quickly, so they often hold core inflation up.
segments.tr: - **Logement.** Les loyers et les coûts liés au logement représentent la plus grande part de l'indice. Ils évoluent lentement, mais baissent rarement rapidement, ce qui maintient souvent l'inflation sous-jacente à un niveau élevé.

segments.src: - **Food.** Grocery and restaurant prices can add or subtract a few hundredths of a percentage point depending on the month.
segments.tr: - **Alimentation.** Les prix des produits d'épicerie et des restaurants peuvent ajouter ou soustraire quelques centièmes de point de pourcentage selon le mois.

segments.src: - **Services.** Items such as medical care, insurance, and transportation services have been persistent sources of upward pressure in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Services.** Des éléments tels que les soins médicaux, l'assurance et les services de transport ont été des sources persistantes de pression à la hausse ces dernières années.

segments.src: - **Goods.** Prices for many manufactured goods have been flatter, which helps offset some of the pressure from services.
segments.tr: - **Biens.** Les prix de nombreux biens manufacturés ont été plus stables, ce qui contribue à compenser une partie de la pression exercée par les services.

segments.src: A core reading of 0.3% suggests that underlying price growth remains steady rather than accelerating.
segments.tr: Une lecture sous-jacente de 0,3 % suggère que la croissance des prix sous-jacents reste stable plutôt qu'elle n'accélère.

segments.src: It also shows that it hasn't cooled as much as policymakers might prefer.
segments.tr: Elle montre également qu'elle n'a pas ralenti autant que les décideurs politiques pourraient le souhaiter.

segments.src: It is tempting to treat each monthly report as a verdict.
segments.tr: Il est tentant de traiter chaque rapport mensuel comme un verdict.

segments.src: Economists are generally more careful, for several reasons.
segments.tr: Les économistes font généralement preuve de plus de prudence, et ce pour plusieurs raisons.

segments.src: **Monthly data is noisy.** Seasonal adjustments, weather events, and temporary supply disruptions can all distort a single month.
segments.tr: **Les données mensuelles sont bruitées.** Les ajustements saisonniers, les événements météorologiques et les perturbations temporaires de l'approvisionnement peuvent tous fausser un mois particulier.

segments.src: A figure that looks high may be partly reversed the next month.
segments.tr: Un chiffre qui paraît élevé peut être en partie inversé le mois suivant.

segments.src: **Energy can reverse.** If the increase came from a short-term spike in fuel or utility costs, prices may ease later.
segments.tr: **L'énergie peut s'inverser.** Si la hausse provient d'une poussée à court terme des coûts du carburant ou des services publics, les prix pourraient se détendre par la suite.

segments.src: The effect on headline inflation would then fade.
segments.tr: L'effet sur l'inflation globale s'estomperait alors.

segments.src: **Core is the steadier guide.** Because core inflation strips out the most volatile items, many analysts consider it a better signal of where prices are going over the next several months.
segments.tr: **L'indice sous-jacent est un guide plus stable.** Étant donné que l'inflation sous-jacente élimine les éléments les plus volatils, de nombreux analystes estiment qu'elle constitue un meilleur indicateur de l'orientation des prix au cours des prochains mois.

segments.src: A steady 0.3% is neither a clear sign of re-acceleration nor of a sustained cooling.
segments.tr: Un taux stable de 0,3 % n'est ni un signe clair de réaccélération ni d'un ralentissement durable.

segments.src: **Trends matter more than points.** Analysts often look at three-month and six-month averages, as well as year-over-year changes, to see through temporary swings.
segments.tr: **Les tendances comptent plus que les points isolés.** Les analystes examinent souvent les moyennes sur trois et six mois, ainsi que les variations d'une année sur l'autre, pour faire abstraction des fluctuations temporaires.

segments.src: One reading above forecasts does not establish a new trend, just as one below forecasts would not have ended the debate.
segments.tr: Une lecture supérieure aux prévisions n'établit pas une nouvelle tendance, de même qu'une lecture inférieure aux prévisions n'aurait pas clos le débat.

segments.src: **Revisions and surveys can change the picture.** Government statistical agencies sometimes revise earlier figures, and surveys of consumers and businesses offer additional context about price expectations.
segments.tr: **Les révisions et les enquêtes peuvent modifier la perspective.** Les agences statistiques gouvernementales révisent parfois les chiffres précédents, et les enquêtes auprès des consommateurs et des entreprises offrent un contexte supplémentaire sur les attentes en matière de prix.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Households
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les ménages

segments.src: For most households, the practical effect of an energy-led increase shows up at the gas pump and on utility bills.
segments.tr: Pour la plupart des ménages, l'effet pratique d'une augmentation tirée par l'énergie se fait sentir à la pompe et sur les factures de services publics.

segments.src: Those costs are hard to avoid, so they can feel larger than the headline number suggests.
segments.tr: Ces coûts sont difficiles à éviter, de sorte qu'ils peuvent sembler plus importants que ne le suggère le chiffre global.

segments.src: Higher energy costs may also leave less room in budgets for other spending.
segments.tr: Des coûts énergétiques plus élevés peuvent également laisser moins de marge dans les budgets pour d'autres dépenses.

segments.src: Some general points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: Quelques points généraux à garder à l'esprit :

segments.src: - Track your own spending categories rather than relying only on national averages. Your personal inflation rate depends on what you buy.
segments.tr: - Suivez vos propres catégories de dépenses plutôt que de vous fier uniquement aux moyennes nationales. Votre taux d'inflation personnel dépend de ce que vous achetez.

segments.src: - Seasonal changes in heating and cooling costs can be planned for ahead of time.
segments.tr: - Les variations saisonnières des coûts de chauffage et de climatisation peuvent être anticipées à l'avance.

segments.src: - Short-term price moves in energy often don't last, so large financial decisions made on one month's data carry more risk.
segments.tr: - Les fluctuations de prix à court terme dans l'énergie ne durent souvent pas, de sorte que les grandes décisions financières prises sur la base des données d'un seul mois comportent plus de risques.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## À surveiller ensuite

segments.src: Several indicators will help show whether October was a one-off or part of a broader pattern:
segments.tr: Plusieurs indicateurs aideront à déterminer si le mois d'octobre était un cas isolé ou faisait partie d'une tendance plus large :

segments.src: - **Next month's CPI report**, especially the core figure and the energy component.
segments.tr: - **Le rapport sur l'IPC du mois prochain**, en particulier le chiffre sous-jacent et la composante énergétique.

segments.src: - **Wholesale and producer prices**, which can signal pressure that has not yet reached consumers.
segments.tr: - **Les prix de gros et à la production**, qui peuvent signaler des pressions n'ayant pas encore atteint les consommateurs.

segments.src: - **Wage growth**, since rising pay can sustain demand for services.
segments.tr: - **La croissance des salaires**, dans la mesure où la hausse des rémunérations peut soutenir la demande de services.

segments.src: - **Central bank communications**, which show how policymakers read the data and whether they see risks to their inflation goal.
segments.tr: - **Les communications de la banque centrale**, qui montrent comment les décideurs interprètent les données et s'ils perçoivent des risques pour leur objectif d'inflation.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: October's 0.4% increase was a firmer reading than expected, and energy did much of the work.
segments.tr: La hausse de 0,4 % enregistrée en octobre s'est avérée plus ferme que prévu, et l'énergie y a grandement contribué.

segments.src: With core inflation steady at 0.3%, the report points to ongoing but not accelerating underlying price pressure.
segments.tr: L'inflation sous-jacente restant stable à 0,3 %, le rapport indique des pressions sur les prix sous-jacents qui se poursuivent sans toutefois s'accélérer.

segments.src: A single month is a data point, not a trend, and the inflation debate will turn on whether the coming months confirm or reverse what October showed.
segments.tr: Un seul mois constitue un point de données, non une tendance, et le débat sur l'inflation dépendra de la confirmation ou de l'inversion par les mois à venir de ce qu'a montré le mois d'octobre.
